name: Gorge grants and refreshes 10 Pooled Vitality stacks every 5 sec (#3446)
contract: Spell.dbc gives Gorge 804805 DurationIndex 8 (15000 ms), AttributesEx5 0x200 (SPELL_ATTR5_EXTRA_INITIAL_PERIOD, so it ticks at 0/5/10/15 s) and effect 0 = aura 23 (SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL) with Amplitude 5000 and TriggerSpell 520318. 520318 carries effect 175 (SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_AURA_STACKS) with MiscValue 10 and TriggerSpell 680687 (Pooled Vitality, StackAmount 10, DurationIndex 2). The tooltip - 'Instantly gain 10 stacks of Pooled Vitality every 5 sec for 15 sec' - is met by native code alone: AuraEffect::HandlePeriodicTriggerSpellAuraTick casts the child with TRIGGERED_FULL_MASK and Spell::EffectAscensionModifyAuraStacks -> ModifyAscensionAuraStacks adds the stacks or applies the aura with them. No module script is involved, so this scenario is a regression guard, not a fix check. Ten is already the cap, so the periodic half is proven by the duration refresh instead: ModifyAscensionAuraStacks calls Aura::ModStackAmount, which refreshes timers for every aura except the Stormbringer/Earthshaping special cases.

steps.label: Let level scaling and login settle
Past the initial period at t+0
The initial tick grants the full 10 Pooled Vitality stacks
Gorge is on its 90 sec cooldown
Pooled Vitality duration just before the second tick
The 5 sec tick refreshed Pooled Vitality instead of letting it run down
The refreshed aura is still capped at 10 stacks
